lines: In contrast to Ange's listless tone, a myriad of mechanized tentacles violently struck Juno with a storm of blows.
However, Juno didn't even try to dodge them.
Oh no. At this rate, Juno might really lo～se♪
Easily fending off all the attacks with hardly a scratch, she was playfully pretending to be hurt.
Or rather, it wasn't a matter of strength. I just had hardly any chance to develop a strategy.
Since she was a veritable mythological monster, it was only natural.
Ahahahahahah! Do you wanna give up and get married now!?
What should we do...? Maybe we're finished.
Hey, it's not over till it's over!
Perhaps we have no choice but to get married.
Now, make your choice! Live happily in marriage... or be eternally bound in death!
Juno began to flicker the light of blessing on her hand as if to count down.
Did I really have no choice but to get married?
Wasn't there any way to outsmart this malicious goddess?
"Chance"ー The word sounded somewhat familiar to me.
And I remembered that some of the A-B-G members had been saying something like "Today is the last chance for them."
What could that have possibly meant??
Today? What date was it again? Yes, it was June 30th...
That's it! June Bride! That's the secret of your blessing!
Huh? Wait, you're only just realizing this?
My thought was right on the mark!
It was one of the European customs that women would choose to get married in June, seeking blessing from the Goddess Juno.
It was something girls would dream of when they were little.
The time... what time was it!?
Which meant, it was already July.
Haha, just leave this to me.
Really? So you'd actually marry a total stranger! Ahahahahahaha!
Kiss each other for me. Then your marriage will become eternal♪
After I said so with a nod, I began to speak in a theatrical voice.
Ohhh noooooooooo!! Isn't that impossible right now?
Huh? What are you talking about?
Better check your calendar. June's already finished. It's July now, Juno-sama.
Juno glanced around, and as if she suddenly saw something...
Aghhhhhh!! Damn it!! This is all because of you two beating around the bush!!
What a shame! Don't tell me we can't have eternal marriage! This sucks! Right, Ange?
Or maybe we should just make a vow without Juno-sama? We never really needed blessings or June Bride or whatever anyway.
You can't do that! That's absolutely positively not allowed!!
Next year then! Just you wait, I'm gonna give you two blessings next June no matter what!
Yeah yeah, I gotcha. I'll make sure to write my vows by then.
Hmph! I'll make you pay for this!
Juno let her halo of light shine violently as if to vent her rage on me and disappeared.
Who's to say whether it could've been considered a blessing or a curse, but its effects had already faded, and our clothes were back to normal.
What would have happened if it wasn't June 30th?
No, technically it was already July.
I thought we were really getting married.
Ange's voice sounded as monotonous as ever. I had no idea what she was thinking.
Juno had already left, but in actuality, Ange here was the real cause of all this chaos in the first place.
Come to think of it... there was something else bothering me at that time...
Hey, you knew who I was before you even dragged me into these shenanigans, didn't you? What's the deal with that?
I heard about you from Asuka.
I had almost forgotten Ange was a subordinate of Masked Taimanin.
And a modified human at that. It was only natural that she and Asuka knew each other.
She said you're too nice to leave someone in trouble.
Could people maybe be a little more considerate before they decide to send trouble my way?
I couldn't help but breathe a deep sigh at Ange whose face was absolutely devoid of any ill will.
Make sure you tell her that she owes me one for this.
Ange nodded, but then abruptly changed the subject with a question.
Did I look good in that wedding dress?
That came out of nowhere. Why do you ask?
I wondered what had gotten into her all of a sudden.
Well, if you insist, I'd say it wasn't too bad.
I wasn't lying, but I probably had a pretty sour look on my face as I said it.
On the other hand, Ange looked quite pleased by my answer, a smile playing about her lips.
I wouldn't mind wearing it again for you.
What are we gonna do next year? Maybe she'll come again. Juno, I mean.
W-We'll think about it when the time comes! Anyway, let's get out of here for now!
And so, we headed toward the entrance of the cave.
However, waiting for us outside wasー
Fuma! What the hell were you doing in there?!
Why on earth are you bringing a girl to a place like this?!
D-Did you really get married? Are you already done with wedding things? Like cutting the cake? The first night, too!?
Everyone was there in full force.
And the members of the A-B-G could also be seen lying on the ground here and there, beaten to a pulp.
You guys... how'd you know about this place?
I had no energy left in me to run away from them.
We just followed the sense of the goddess's presence after we heard that guy was the one who summoned her.
Sakura pointed at one of the A-B-G members, who was in a particularly terrible state.
He was covered in burns, cuts, and octopus ink, but it seemed like he was still alive at least.
What kind of losers think of forcing someone into marriage by using the powers of a goddess? So gross.
Hebiko can't just let that slide.
I don't like the idea either.
It seemed like they'd learned the details of our situation from the A-B-G members when they'd taken the fools down.
Yeah, I had a hell of a bad time thanks to these guys.
I made a face as if to say, "sheesh," but everyone glared at me in unison.
So, what's the deal? Did you marry that girl with the blessing from the goddess?
No way. The goddess already left. And there's no stupid blessing, either.
Everything's fine now. I'm not gonna marry her. So don't worry.
For some reason, I felt that their gazes were filled with animosity.
Well then, care to explain why you look like you're still glued together at the hands?
I reflexively looked down at my hand.
I hadn't noticed until Hebiko pointed it out.
Ange and I were indeed holding hands in quite the harmonious display.
Y-You got it wrong! Th-This is, umm, because some of the goddess's curse was still left in us, yeah!
I hurriedly let Ange's hand go.
Oh yeah. It's gone. It sure is gone. Right, Ange? You don't feel anything weird, right?
Th-There, happy? She said she doesn't feel anything either, see?
I'm all fine now, so I gotta go now.
A m-mission? Hey, hold on a sec! You gotta give them some kind of explanation too!
Well then, see you next year.
Ange spoke her dry goodbye and then used her tentacles to jump out of the scene.
...Umm, so there's nothing between us, you know?
Hey, what did she mean by "see you next year?"
My, my, Fuma-kun. Something did happen between you two, didn't iiiit?
Oh, it did! He's hiding something for sure!
Well, what is it?! Answer or Hebiko'll interrogate you as your class rep!!
Even after Juno and Ange had left, and even after it had become the next month, the ordeals that had fallen upon me in June were unending.
Ahhgh! If there's a God of July out there, please help me!!
